title: Lifting a factorization modulo pi^8 (Popescu)
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra and $\pi\in R$ with $\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi)=\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi^2)$ and $\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi)=\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi^2)$ (annihilators of $\pi,\pi^2$ in $R$ and of their images in $\Lambda$). Let $A\to\Lambda$ be a homomorphism of $R$-algebras with $A$ of finite presentation over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and assume the image of $\pi$ in $A$ is strictly standard in $A$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element]. Let $A/\pi^8A\to\bar C\to\Lambda/\pi^8\Lambda$ be a factorization, by homomorphisms of $R/\pi^8R$-algebras, of the map $A/\pi^8A\to\Lambda/\pi^8\Lambda$ induced by $A\to\Lambda$, with $\bar C$ of finite presentation over $R/\pi^8R$. Then there is a factorization $A\to B\to\Lambda$ of $A\to\Lambda$ by homomorphisms of $R$-algebras with $B$ of finite presentation over $R$ such that (a) $R_\pi\to B_\pi$ is smooth [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], where $R_\pi$, $B_\pi$ are the localizations at the powers of $\pi$ (resp. of its image in $B$); (b) the ideal of $\Lambda/\pi^8\Lambda$ generated by the image of $H_{\bar C/(R/\pi^8R)}$ under $\bar C\to\Lambda/\pi^8\Lambda$ is contained in the image in $\Lambda/\pi^8\Lambda$ of $\sqrt{H_{B/R}\Lambda}$, the radical of the ideal of $\Lambda$ generated by the image of $H_{B/R}$ under $B\to\Lambda$; here $H_{\bar C/(R/\pi^8R)}$ and $H_{B/R}$ are singular ideals [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F0 (lemma-desingularize-lifting-apply, line 1862), Section 07CN (section-lifting-lemma); its proof applies Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting) and Lemma 07CT (lemma-desingularize-strictly-standard) and omits the final verification
